# Prompts of the `full` arm (ADR-013)

Copies of the agent prompts as they were when Phase 6 was specified, before the passages that depend
on the semantic layer were marked. `tests/test_ablation.py` checks that loading a prompt with the
semantic layer on gives exactly these files, so the `full` arm of the evaluation runs the prompts the
earlier phases ran.

If you edit a prompt on purpose, update the copy here in the same commit, and say so in the report
of any run that spans the change.
